what: Seller reports their USA manufacturer Etsy account was permanently suspended over handmade authenticity doubts, despite sending five appeal emails with proof including video of their manufacturing process.
verbatim_snippet: "My account suspended incorrectly :'We let you know on Sep 06, 2024 that your account was suspended. It looks like you didn't appeal your suspension within six months of this date, so your account is now permanently suspended.' today is april 2025 · absolutely incorrect , I have 5 emails sent to etsy rep with requested information ... I did nothing wrong -they doubt i make my items myself and i sent them video of process and other proof, please help to reinstate USA manufacturer account."
notes: community.etsy.com requires login after Bevy platform migration. Content retrieved from Google search index of this URL. Poster: handyctcom (posting on behalf of WestfieldArt account). USA manufacturer. Suspension originated September 2024, became permanent by April 2025. Ellipsis ("...") appears to be poster's original punctuation consistent with informal writing style throughout. Character-for-character accuracy limited to Google's indexed cache.
